integrity: Complete analytic proof and standalone exact-rational checks; finite tests do not certify asymptotic statements; independent mathematical or historical-priority audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite initial graph containing both types; two types with fair independent arrivals; one edge per step; symmetric fixed affinity q strictly between zero and one; degree exponent zero. No results for positive exponent, asymmetric types or weights. The compensator fluctuations are not directly visible on the uncorrected sqrt(n) edge-count scale. No finite-n CLT rate proved.
title: A logarithmic assortativity bias and two independent fluctuation scales in soft two-community attachment
